card.title: STREET RUMBLE
card.tagline: THE GANG'S ALL HERE. AND THEY'RE ALL MAD.

twist.title: FOOT CHOPPER OVERHEAD!
twist.sub: HIDE BEHIND THE ROOF HATCHES - DON'T GET LIT UP

card.title: SEWER SHOWDOWN
card.tagline: HOLD YOUR NOSE. HOLD YOUR GROUND.

twist.title: THE SLUICE GATE BURST!
twist.sub: OUTRUN THE FLOOD - GET TO THE LADDER

lines.intro: SURF'S UP, SHELLBACKS! THIS IS MY SWAMP!
lines.ko: GLUB... I'M... GOIN' DOWN THE DRAIN...

card.title: SUNSET SHRED
card.tagline: SKATE FAST. DODGE TRAFFIC. DON'T LOOK DOWN.

twist.title: MAN THE WATER CANNON!
twist.sub: UP / DOWN TO AIM - ATTACK TO FIRE

lines.intro: THIS LANE'S A TOLL ROAD, SHELLS. AND I'M THE TOLL!

card.title: DOCKSIDE DOUBLE-CROSS
card.tagline: SOMEBODY'S SMUGGLING TROUBLE BY THE CRATE.

twist.title: HARBOUR CHASE!
twist.sub: FOOT JET-SKIS INCOMING - HOLD THE DECK

lines.intro: WELCOME ABOARD, SHELLFISH! NOW WALK THE PLANK!

card.title: FROSTBITE BOULEVARD
card.tagline: BUNDLE UP. THE GANG BROUGHT A COLD FRONT.

twist.title: THIN ICE!
twist.sub: DON'T STAND STILL - THE POND CRACKS

card.title: SCRAPYARD SMASH
card.tagline: ONE GUY'S TRASH IS ANOTHER GUY'S WEAPON.

twist.title: GOING DOWN!
twist.sub: THE FREIGHT LIFT DROPS INTO THE SMELTER

lines.intro: NOTHING LEAVES MY YARD IN ONE PIECE!
hit: I'LL PRESS YOU INTO A CUBE!

card.title: FORTRESS OF RAZORBACK
card.tagline: THE FINAL SHOWDOWN. BRING AMBER HOME.

twist.title: LOCKDOWN SWEEP!
twist.sub: STAY OUT OF THE LIGHTS - HIDE BEHIND COVER

lines.intro: SO THE SHELLS CRAWLED IN AT LAST.

card.title: SHADOWS OF EDO
card.tagline: THE RIFT THREW US BACK 400 YEARS. AND THE NINJAS WERE WAITING.

twist.title: THE RONIN AT THE GATE
twist.sub: BREAK HIS GUARD WITH JUMP ATTACKS AND THROWS

lines.intro: SO THE RIFT DELIVERS TURTLES TO MY DOOR.

card.title: PIRATE SHIP
card.tagline: THE RIFT DROPS YOU INTO 1687. REPEL BOARDERS!

twist.title: BROADSIDE! THE MAST IS GOING!
twist.sub: THE DECK IS SPLITTING - KEEP OFF THE HOLES

lines.intro: FRESH SHELLFISH! I'LL CRACK YOU OPEN!

twist.title: HANDCAR PURSUIT!
twist.sub: HIT THE OUTLAW CAR'S SHIELD 3 TIMES - TWICE

lines.intro: WELL, LOOKY HERE! TURTLE SOUP, COMIN' UP!
lines.ko: BEAT... BY A BUNCH O' BABY TURTLES...

card.title: FUTURE NYC 2105
card.tagline: THE RIFT DROPPED US IN THE FAST LANE.

twist.title: HACK THE GATE!
twist.sub: KEEP THEM OFF THE BOT WHILE IT WORKS

lines.intro: WELCOME TO 2105, TURTLES. THIS CITY RUNS ON ME.
lines.summon: WHICH ONE OF ME IS REAL?
lines.ko: ERROR... ERROR... THE RIFT... IS PULLING ME...

card.title: DIMENSION X
card.tagline: THE RIFT SPITS US OUT... ON AN ALIEN WORLD.

twist.title: SEIZE THE CANNON!
twist.sub: SHOOT THE DROP-PODS BEFORE THEY LAND

lines.intro: TURTLES! IN DIMENSION X? YOU'RE A LONG WAY FROM HOME!

card.title: TECHNODROME PORTAL
card.tagline: THE WAR MACHINE IS PHASING INTO NEW YORK!

twist.title: TENDRIL ALLEY!
twist.sub: MAKE THE EL OVERPASS BEFORE THE PORTAL SURGE

card.title: SHREDDER'S TOWER
card.tagline: THE TRUE FINALE. END THIS, BROTHERS.

lines.intro: THE OOZE HAS MADE ME... INVINCIBLE!
lines.ko: IMPOSSIBLE... THE POWER... IT'S TEARING ME APART...!
